indexing: i indexes a unique economic lifecycle; a indexes an actor when actor-specific
economic_definition: Stable identifier for one economically coherent lifecycle.
economic_mechanism: Prevents repeated logs from being treated as independent economic choices.
hypothesis_role: All events belonging to one lifecycle map to one episode.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.oo_request_id; uma_dvm_requests.dvm_request_id
missing_value_rule: Never impute; an unresolvable native id excludes the row.
validation_rule: Unique inside protocol, chain and native unit; deterministic under reruns.
measurement_limitations: The same cross-chain lifecycle may have multiple native identifiers; link grade must be retained.

mathematical_definition: t_i^d = block_timestamp(first decision event for i)
economic_definition: Time at which an economic actor must choose an action.
economic_mechanism: Defines the information set and prevents future leakage.
hypothesis_role: Only evidence with timestamp <= t_i^d may enter an agent decision.
source_mapping: polygon_oov2_events.block_time for RequestPrice/ProposePrice/DisputePrice
missing_value_rule: Null if the native event has no block timestamp; never replace with settlement time.
validation_rule: Timestamp equals the canonical block timestamp for the cited transaction.
measurement_limitations: A request contains several decision times; the actor role must specify which one is used.

economic_definition: Last time at which the proposal can be disputed under the recorded request parameters.
economic_mechanism: Defines the monitoring window and the option value of waiting.
hypothesis_role: Longer windows may increase verification opportunity and capital lock.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.expiration_time from ProposePrice
missing_value_rule: Null before proposal or when expirationTime is absent; not zero.
validation_rule: d_i >= proposal_time_i and matches the ProposePrice event payload.
measurement_limitations: Deadline is protocol time, not proof that any monitor observed the proposal.

economic_definition: Principal placed at risk by the proposal and, when challenged, the dispute.
economic_mechanism: Risk-bearing commitment and the private cost of an incorrect claim.
hypothesis_role: Higher B_i may deter frivolous proposals/challenges but raises entry and capital costs.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.effective_bond_raw; currency supplies the asset
missing_value_rule: Null when no proposal exists; a source value of 0 is verified zero.
validation_rule: Integer string; positive for proposed requests; reconcile with token transfers.
measurement_limitations: Request-level bond does not alone identify each actor's duration of exposure.

economic_definition: Reward offered by the requester before a report is supplied.
economic_mechanism: Ex-ante incentive for costly information production/reporting.
hypothesis_role: A larger configured reward may attract participation but is not yet realized income.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.question_reward_raw (cross-check reward_raw)
missing_value_rule: Null means the request parameter was not recovered; zero is a valid no-reward request.
validation_rule: question_reward_raw = reward_raw where both are populated.
measurement_limitations: Configured reward may later be refunded or rolled and must not be labelled paid.

economic_definition: Configured compensation relative to capital placed at risk.
economic_mechanism: Incentive intensity and risk-return trade-off.
hypothesis_role: Higher rho_i may affect proposal or dispute participation conditional on observable selection.
source_mapping: question_reward_raw / effective_bond_raw within the same asset and decimals
missing_value_rule: Null when B_i is null or zero; never divide by zero or combine assets.
validation_rule: Both inputs share currency; ratio is nonnegative and recomputable from raw integers.
measurement_limitations: Not a causal incentive estimate; request composition and adapter versions confound comparisons.

economic_definition: Whether at least one actor paid the on-chain cost to challenge the proposal.
economic_mechanism: Costly monitoring and public-good provision.
hypothesis_role: Low dispute rates may reflect agreement, weak monitoring, or high challenge cost; they do not prove truth.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.dispute_tx; polygon_oov2_events.event='DisputePrice'
missing_value_rule: 0 only when the full challenge window is observed; otherwise right-censored/null.
validation_rule: One request has at most one canonical dispute event in OOV2; transaction and event agree.
measurement_limitations: Undisputed acceptance is a protocol outcome, not independent factual correctness.

economic_definition: Whether the DVM-supported settlement agrees with the proposal.
economic_mechanism: Ex-post adjudication of the challenger/proposer conflict.
hypothesis_role: Conditional outcome for studying challenge precision, not population truth accuracy.
source_mapping: proposed_price_raw and resolved_price_raw; Grade-A DVM link where cross-chain
missing_value_rule: Null for undisputed, unresolved or non-exactly linked requests.
validation_rule: For Grade-A links, DVM, child-pushed and OOV2 settled prices must be consistent.
measurement_limitations: Protocol resolution may differ from independent ground truth.

economic_definition: Protocol-defined minimum period during which a proposal remains challengeable.
economic_mechanism: Institutional delay that enables monitoring but locks capital.
hypothesis_role: Separates designed waiting time from excess operational delay.
source_mapping: expiration_time minus ProposePrice.block_time
missing_value_rule: Null when either timestamp is missing; never assume the default liveness.
validation_rule: W_i >= 0; compare to exact event payload and contract version.
measurement_limitations: The period can be request-specific and must not be filled from the current global default.

economic_definition: Elapsed calendar time from request initiation to settlement.
economic_mechanism: Total institutional and operational friction.
hypothesis_role: Longer delay increases uncertainty and may increase capital opportunity cost.
source_mapping: Settle.block_time - RequestPrice.block_time
missing_value_rule: Right-censored at the fixed cutoff for unsettled requests.
validation_rule: Nonnegative; both timestamps come from canonical event logs.
measurement_limitations: Does not by itself identify which stage caused delay.

indexing: i=settled OOV2 request with observed W_i
economic_definition: Delay beyond the protocol-defined challenge window.
economic_mechanism: Operational friction net of mandatory institutional waiting.
hypothesis_role: Separates design-imposed waiting from settlement execution latency.
source_mapping: settlement_delay_seconds - mandatory_wait_seconds
missing_value_rule: Null unless both L_i and W_i are known.
validation_rule: X_i >= 0 and inputs trace to event timestamps.
measurement_limitations: For disputed requests, DVM adjudication is part of excess delay and should later be decomposed.

indexing: i=settled OOV2 request and economic winner
economic_definition: Non-principal compensation actually embedded in the verified settlement transfer.
economic_mechanism: Realized incentive payment.
hypothesis_role: Distinguishes promised reward from realized income.
source_mapping: explicit_report_reward_raw + dispute_winner_reward_raw; settlement transfer QC
missing_value_rule: Null when unsettled or transfer evidence unavailable; zero is valid after exact decomposition.
validation_rule: principal_returned + reward_paid = gross_payout where protocol fees are handled by the rule; flow QC exact.
measurement_limitations: Request-level winner payment requires an actor-role table before individual net payoff analysis.

indexing: i=settled OOV2 request and settlement recipient
economic_definition: Recovery of previously locked principal; not income.
economic_mechanism: Capital recovery and exposure closure.
hypothesis_role: Separating return of capital prevents payout from overstating rewards.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.principal_returned_raw
missing_value_rule: Null when unsettled; zero only when exact decomposition proves no principal return.
validation_rule: Must be reconciled within the same transaction and asset; never counted as reward.
measurement_limitations: A request aggregate may combine multiple principal components; actor allocation must be explicit.

mathematical_definition: F_i^bond = losing bond amount not returned
economic_definition: Principal lost by the economically losing side of a dispute.
economic_mechanism: Penalty enforcement and risk realization.
hypothesis_role: Measures realized downside rather than a configured slash parameter.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.bond_forfeited_raw
missing_value_rule: Null outside a settled eligible dispute; verified zero only after complete decomposition.
validation_rule: Positive only for settled disputed requests; reconcile winner transfer and protocol fee.
measurement_limitations: Final fee and redistributed bond components must remain separately identified.

mathematical_definition: C_i^fee = protocol fee transferred from disputed escrow
economic_definition: On-chain fee retained or routed by the mechanism during dispute settlement.
economic_mechanism: Mechanism operation cost paid from escrow.
hypothesis_role: Reduces private net payoff and may affect willingness to challenge.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.protocol_fee_raw and final_fee_forfeited_raw
missing_value_rule: Null outside eligible settled disputes; do not infer from current fee parameters.
validation_rule: Reconcile with settlement transaction flows and economic rule id.
measurement_limitations: Protocol fee is not the off-chain social cost of adjudication.

mathematical_definition: G_i = total settlement transfer to recipient
economic_definition: Total transferred amount, including returned principal and reward components; it is not an economic reward.
economic_mechanism: Cash-flow reconciliation variable, not an economic reward measure.
hypothesis_role: Used only to verify decomposition; treating G_i as reward overstates incentives.
source_mapping: polygon_uma_request_rounds.gross_payout_raw; request flow QC
missing_value_rule: Null when unsettled or transfer unavailable.
validation_rule: gross_payout_raw equals settlement_transfer_raw for all exact-QC settlements.
measurement_limitations: Cannot be compared as income without subtracting capital and fees.

economic_definition: Actor-specific realized economic gain or loss excluding returned principal.
economic_mechanism: Private economic consequence of reporting, monitoring or challenging.
hypothesis_role: Outcome for incentive compatibility and economic-regret evaluation.
source_mapping: Requires role-resolved token flows plus gas receipts and reward/forfeiture decomposition
missing_value_rule: Null unless all included components share asset and actor attribution; never treat missing cost as zero.
validation_rule: Component sum reconciles to actor-address flows; principal return excluded.
measurement_limitations: Current request table is not fully actor-role normalized and gas coverage is incomplete.

measurement_unit: raw token units multiplied by days
economic_definition: Quantity of capital tied up over time in its native asset.
economic_mechanism: Liquidity constraint and capital opportunity cost.
hypothesis_role: Higher K may discourage participation even if expected payoff is positive.
source_mapping: bond lock/release token flows and their block timestamps
missing_value_rule: Right-censored capital-days use cutoff duration and retain censor flag; never sum across assets.
validation_rule: Release time cannot precede lock time; asset address and decimals remain attached.
measurement_limitations: Request-level principal is available, but exact actor-specific lock timestamps require a normalized flow lifecycle.

economic_definition: Direct blockchain execution cost paid by the acting account.
economic_mechanism: Participation and verification cost.
hypothesis_role: Higher execution costs can suppress monitoring and challenge activity.
source_mapping: transaction receipt gasUsed and effectiveGasPrice for proposal/dispute/settlement actions
missing_value_rule: Null when receipt is absent; never zero-fill missing receipts.
validation_rule: Recompute product from hexadecimal receipt fields and match transaction sender.
measurement_limitations: Current archives cover targeted dispute and settlement receipts, not every relevant action uniformly.

economic_definition: Total private cost of investigating and executing a verification action.
economic_mechanism: Costly information acquisition and public-good provision.
hypothesis_role: Challenge occurs only when expected benefit exceeds verification and risk cost.
source_mapping: gas receipts plus externally measured labor/API/time costs and timestamped FX conversion
missing_value_rule: Null if any required cost component is unavailable; partial cost must be labelled partial.
validation_rule: Each USD component cites source and conversion time; no silent zero labor cost.
references: NIST AI RMF characteristics; economic cost-accounting design in project guidance; https://doi.org/10.1016/0022-0531(79)90031-0; https://www.jstor.org/stable/1805228
measurement_limitations: Gas is measured and timestamp-converted for the strict cohort; investigation and labor remain scenario assumptions.
uma_source_tables: trustworthy_ai_usd_economics; Polygon dispute receipts; historical Chainlink proxy state

mathematical_definition: HHI_t = sum_a s_at^2, s_at = challenges_at / sum_b challenges_bt
economic_definition: Concentration of observed challenge activity among monitoring actors.
economic_mechanism: Public-good provision, specialization and monitoring fragility.
hypothesis_role: High concentration can indicate reliance on a small set of monitors, without identifying welfare effects.
source_mapping: disputer addresses from canonical DisputePrice events
missing_value_rule: Null when actor attribution or full window coverage is unavailable; no challenges is not HHI=0.
validation_rule: Shares sum to one within protocol, chain, asset and time window.
measurement_limitations: Address concentration is not entity concentration; sybils and delegated execution remain possible.

mathematical_definition: TopShare_t(k) = sum_{a=1}^k s_(a)t for preregistered k in {1,5,10}
indexing: a=challenger ordered by activity share; t=preregistered protocol-time window
economic_definition: Share of observed challenge activity supplied by the k most active monitoring addresses.
economic_mechanism: Verification concentration and dependence on a small monitor set.
hypothesis_role: A high top-k share indicates operational reliance on few addresses, not necessarily few entities.
source_mapping: canonical DisputePrice disputer addresses aggregated within protocol, chain, asset and time window
missing_value_rule: Null when the complete window or actor attribution is unavailable; no challenges is undefined, not zero.
validation_rule: Shares use the same denominator as HHI; TopShare_t(k) is nondecreasing in k and at most one.
measurement_limitations: Addresses may be sybils, delegates or shared infrastructure; k must be reported with every value.

indexing: t=preregistered protocol-time window with at least one observed challenge
economic_definition: Inverse-HHI effective number of equally active monitoring addresses.
economic_mechanism: Verification breadth and fragility under unequal participation.
hypothesis_role: Lower effective N indicates that nominal address counts overstate effective monitoring breadth.
source_mapping: monitoring_concentration_hhi derived from canonical DisputePrice disputer shares
missing_value_rule: Null when HHI is null or the window contains no observed challenges; never divide by zero.
validation_rule: N_eff,t lies in [1,n_t] and recomputes exactly as the inverse of the released HHI.
measurement_limitations: Effective address count is not an independently resolved count of human or institutional entities.

mathematical_definition: N_t(tau) = min{k: sum_{a=1}^k s_(a)t >= tau}, tau in {0.5,0.8,0.9}
indexing: a=challenger ordered by activity share; t=window; tau=preregistered coverage threshold
economic_definition: Minimum number of top monitoring addresses needed to supply a specified share of challenges.
economic_mechanism: Threshold dependence and operational concentration of costly verification.
hypothesis_role: Small N_t(tau) indicates that removing a few active addresses could sharply reduce observed monitoring.
source_mapping: canonical DisputePrice disputer shares within the same denominator used by HHI and top-k share
missing_value_rule: Null without a complete nonempty activity window; tau is part of the observation key and cannot be omitted.
validation_rule: N_t(tau) is an integer in [1,n_t] and is nondecreasing in tau.
measurement_limitations: This is an address-activity threshold, not a protocol security threshold or causal failure estimate.

indexing: i=decision episode; a in {Accept,Investigate,Challenge,Abstain}; s=preregistered cost scenario
economic_definition: Expected private utility of a feasible verifier action under a declared information set and cost scenario.
economic_mechanism: Economic incentive compatibility under uncertain protocol outcomes and costly verification.
hypothesis_role: A challenge is privately attractive only when its expected token payoff exceeds Gas, capital and investigation costs.
source_mapping: decision-time calibrated probability; exact protocol payoff mapping; timestamped FX/Gas; registered investigation and APR scenarios
missing_value_rule: Null unless probability, action-contingent payoff and every included cost component are available; scenario assumptions are never observations.
validation_rule: No outcome-only field enters I_i; probabilities sum to one; all action utilities use one registered scenario and USD timestamp policy.
measurement_limitations: Private scenario utility is not social welfare; investigation labor and capital APR remain assumptions.
uma_source_tables: trustworthy_ai_usd_economics; trustworthy_ai_complete_task; historical Chainlink proxy state

mathematical_definition: Q_i in {A,B,C,U} under preregistered matching rules
economic_definition: Strength of evidence that Polygon OOV2 and Ethereum DVM records describe the same dispute.
economic_mechanism: Identification quality for cross-chain adjudication and economic attribution.
hypothesis_role: Only Grade A supports primary cross-chain outcome matching.
source_mapping: uma_polygon_ethereum_grade_a_links.cross_chain_match_grade and exact hash/ancillary checks
missing_value_rule: U means unresolved and must not be treated as a negative match.
validation_rule: Grade A requires exact child request id, parent request id, identifier/time and ancillary match.
measurement_limitations: A correct technical link does not create independent truth for the resolved value.

economic_definition: Request-level accrued redistribution: positive for correct-vote redistribution and negative for wrong/no-vote slash.
economic_mechanism: Voting incentive, participation penalty and redistribution.
hypothesis_role: Connects voting behavior to request-specific economic accrual.
source_mapping: uma_dvm_voter_payoffs.signed_slash_delta_raw from VoterSlashed
missing_value_rule: Null if request-voter event is missing; zero is a real emitted zero delta.
validation_rule: positive + zero + negative classifications are exhaustive; VoterSlashApplied is excluded from this sum.
measurement_limitations: It is accrued to unappliedSlash and is not the same as the later account-level stake mutation.

mathematical_definition: C_i = 1[t_i^terminal is not observed by fixed cutoff T]
economic_definition: Whether the lifecycle remains without an observed terminal event at the fixed release cutoff.
economic_mechanism: Accountability realization and duration measurement under incomplete follow-up.
hypothesis_role: Retention of censored episodes prevents completed-only outcome and delay estimates.
source_mapping: terminal event timestamps, protocol-native open/closed state and fixed cutoff manifest
missing_value_rule: Never infer zero from a missing terminal timestamp unless source coverage through T and finality checks pass.
validation_rule: C_i=0 requires a canonical terminal event at or before T; C_i=1 retains observed duration T-t_i^start.
measurement_limitations: Administrative censoring does not identify the eventual outcome and must not be treated as failure.

economic_definition: Net accumulated slash/redistribution actually applied to the voter stake balance.
economic_mechanism: Realized account-level balance mutation.
hypothesis_role: Supports stake reconciliation but not request-level causal attribution.
source_mapping: uma_dvm_staking_events VoterSlashApplied raw_data_words and emitted postStake
missing_value_rule: Null when application has not occurred by cutoff; not zero.
validation_rule: pre-stake + applied delta = emitted postStake subject to zero floor; never add VoterSlashed again.
measurement_limitations: One application can aggregate multiple request-level accruals.

mathematical_definition: G_i = 1[independent, timestamped reference outcome passes validation]
economic_definition: Whether outcome correctness can be judged independently of the protocol's own settlement.
economic_mechanism: Separates protocol consensus from empirical truth.
hypothesis_role: Required before reporting accuracy or truthfulness rather than protocol agreement.
source_mapping: validated external source record linked to immutable request semantics and resolution rule
missing_value_rule: 0 only after an explicit coverage audit; otherwise unavailable/null.
validation_rule: External source timestamp and extraction rule are preserved and independent of model output.
measurement_limitations: Available for a deterministic Binance-candle subcohort; most requests still provide only protocol outcomes.

economic_definition: Ex-post private token payoff forgone relative to the better of taking no token action and challenging.
economic_mechanism: Action quality under asymmetric bond/reward consequences.
hypothesis_role: Tests whether an action policy improves private token outcomes before Gas and investigation costs.
source_mapping: exact OOV2 winner reward, losing bond/final-fee forfeiture, protocol outcome, and registered agent action
missing_value_rule: Null for Investigate because its subsequent action and investigation cost are unobserved; never subtract MATIC Gas from USDC.
validation_rule: Computed within one token address and decimals; challenge payoff reconciles to exact settlement flows.
measurement_limitations: Partial private-payoff regret only: excludes Gas, labor, external harm, independent truth and USD welfare.

mathematical_definition: Regret_i = max_a U_i(a | I_i) - U_i(a_agent | I_i)
economic_definition: Economic loss from the agent's chosen action relative to the best feasible action under the preregistered payoff model.
economic_mechanism: Decision quality under costly verification, uncertainty and abstention.
hypothesis_role: Evaluates whether predictive gains survive action costs and asymmetric errors.
source_mapping: decision-time evidence, realized protocol outcome, cost matrix, gas and capital costs
missing_value_rule: Null without a preregistered utility matrix and sufficient realized cost/outcome evidence.
validation_rule: No future fields in I_i; recompute all action utilities and preserve cost assumptions.
references: NIST AI Risk Management Framework; project next-stage guidance; https://airc.nist.gov/airmf-resources/airmf/3-sec-characteristics/
measurement_limitations: Constructed as private-verifier scenario regret with measured FX/Gas/payoff; investigation cost and APR are assumptions, not observations.
uma_source_tables: trustworthy_ai_usd_economics; historical Chainlink proxy state; registered cost scenarios

mathematical_definition: P_i = H(source entities || transformation rule || release version)
economic_definition: Stable pointer to the entities, activities and agents that generated an observation.
economic_mechanism: Accountability, auditability and reproducibility of measurement.
hypothesis_role: Every economic value must be reversible to its primary evidence and transformation.
source_mapping: source transaction/log keys, transformation rule id, code version and release manifest
missing_value_rule: Never optional for released processed observations.
validation_rule: Hash is deterministic; referenced source objects and rules exist and pass checksums.
measurement_limitations: A hash proves identity/integrity of cited inputs, not semantic correctness by itself.
